instruction: An underground cavern of giant crystals: towering amethyst and aquamarine clusters glowing from within, a glassy subterranean lake with perfect reflections, a natural crystal bridge, stalactites dripping, glowworm constellations on the ceiling, scattered mineral shards, and pulsing light that shifts hue slowly through the cavern.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Crystal Cavern Lake. An underground cavern of giant crystals: towering amethyst and aquamarine clusters glowing from within, a glassy subterranean lake with perfect reflections, a natural crystal bridge, stalactites dripping, glowworm constellations on the ceiling, scattered mineral shards, and pulsing light that shifts hue slowly through the cavern. Style: luminous mineral fantasy. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
